intro: Expand your storage with the Slide N Store XL Plus. With spacious interiors, a hidden drawes, and durable sliding doors, it’s designed to elevate functionality without compromising on style.

features.title: Tough yet elegant for daily use
features.text: Engineered with CRCA steel, this wardrobe combines strength with beauty, offering unmatched durability to handle the demands of everyday life while adding a modern touch.

features.title: Spacious storage for effortless organisation
features.text: Designed with mulitple shelves and drawers, it offers ample room to store everything you need, from clothing and accessories to seasonal items.

features.title: Discreet and secure compartment
features.text: Offers a dedicated secret compartment for added safety and privacy, keeping your most valuable possessions secure and out of sight.

features.title: Moving made simple
features.text: Designed with knock-down construction, this wardrobe makes transport and installation stress-free, adapting effortlessly to life’s transitions and relocations.

name: Slide N Store Xl Plus 2-Door Steel Wardrobe Textured Cashmere
